original.target_description: Within-participant crossover comparison of time to exhaustion during high-intensity cycling after 90 min AX-CPT versus control documentaries. Condition effect tested with the printed Hills-Harmitage approach.

n.quote: Individual time to exhaustion was shorter in the ... mental fatigue condition in 13 of 16 subjects.
n.location: p. 860, Results: Effect of Mental Fatigue on Exercise Tolerance
n.sample_role: Participants in the paired crossover time-to-exhaustion comparison; each participant tested in both conditions.
n.exclusions: No target-test exclusions reported; the result explicitly describes individual differences for 16 subjects. The 13 denotes those with shorter time, not a separate final group.

es.quote: Time to exhaustion was significantly lower ... in the mental fatigue condition (640 ⫾ 316 s) compared with ... control (754 ⫾ 339 s) (P ⫽ 0.003)
es.location: p. 860 (PDF page 4), Results: Effect of Mental Fatigue on Exercise Tolerance; p. 859 Statistical Analysis
